title: Milab abductee meets a Nordic on a military base: 'by degrees'

tellings.quote: she asked the Nordic if they were involved with the grace and the reply of the Nordic was by degrees.

plain: A woman who said she had been taken by the military, not only by aliens, said she met a "Nordic" on a military base. A Nordic is a tall, fair, human-looking being in abduction lore. She asked it whether its kind were involved with "the grace", most likely meaning the Greys, the small grey beings of those same stories, and it answered "by degrees." The researcher Tim Alberino retells this from the work of a researcher named Karla Turner and her book Taken. If true, it would mean the military and different kinds of beings work together.
